My scanners identify you as ''Onyx Star'', a ship stolen from my employer by agents of Icaris Tool and Drive.|Jaina Solo and the cyborg pilot|<ref name="The Crystal">{{GamerCite|5|The Crystal}}</ref>}}
During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''cyborg''' operated the modified [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65B X-wing starfighter]] ''[[Bail Jumper]]''. As a result of his cyborg conversion, the cyborg suffered from [[cybernetic psychosis]], rendering the man insane. Driven by his poor mental state, in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]] the cyborg flew his [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] to the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] under the belief that he had been tasked by the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]] to prevent the manufacturing concern [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporation]] from taking possession of the ''[[Onyx Star]]'', a prototype [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] that had been stolen fifty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier. On arrival in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], the cyborg encountered and immediately attacked the Z-95 [[Crystal (starfighter)|''Crystal'']], which was being [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] trainee [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], who was en-route to a family vacation. Ignoring Solo's protests to the contrary, the cyborg convinced himself that Solo's [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] was the ''Onyx Star'' and after the pair engaged in a brief [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]], the ''Bail Jumper'' was destroyed and the cyborg was forced to eject into [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="The Crystal" />
